FUN_00585800.role: Maps a default selector and effect id to the queue-entry visual result class.
observedLogic: FUN_00798370 splits the effect id into category, upper id, and lower id.
Otherwise FUN_007982D0 maps the high-byte category to a resource bucket.
Bucket 8 returns 0x0B; bucket 1 returns 0x0C or 0x0D based on upper-id special cases; buckets 2,3,4,5 return 0x0E,0x0F,0x10,0x11; all other buckets return the caller's default selector.

FUN_00798370.observedLogic: category = effectId >> 24. For category 0x0B, upper id is zero and lower id is the low 24 bits. Otherwise upper id is bits 12..23 and lower id is bits 0..11.

FUN_007982D0.observedLogic: Categories 0..0x22 index DAT_00FE32DC with stride 0x0C: byte 0 primaryEnabled, byte 1 secondaryEnabled, dword +4 resourceBucket, dword +8 prefix pointer. Categories above 0x22 return disabled flags and bucket 0x12.
